newsitem.title: UK: BRITAIN IN LINE FOR HUGE WINTER SPORTS CENTRE.
newsitem.headline: BRITAIN IN LINE FOR HUGE WINTER SPORTS CENTRE.

text.p: Britain could be home to one of the world's largest winter sports centres if a new scheme to build a national centre gets planning permission and lottery funding.

The centre would cater for 14 Winter Olympic sports, including ice hockey, curling and bobsleigh and would offer facilities such as a 550-metre ski slope and 7,000-seater ice rink, partners of the scheme said on Tuesday.
The proposed scheme is expected to cost around 160 million pounds ($270 million) and will be located on a 100-acre site near Brighton on the south coast.
Britain has a very modest record of success in winter sports, having won only 21 Olympic medals.
